decompileSource: not required: every fact below is read from this repository's own sources and from the authoring catalog, not from a native assembly. No game type, no il2cpp interop type and no BepInEx type is named by any source this slice adds.
decompileLimit: The seven rows are an authoring facility, not an observation of the game. What the rows can promise is therefore decided by the runtime SDK's handler surface and by what the kernel exposes to a handler, and both are read here from the working tree rather than decompiled.

authorGate.finding: the author-only boundary already exists three times over and this slice adds no fourth marker
evidence: catalog: every one of the seven rows carries targetOwner "Development"
Release/release.json:204-228 gives the ForgeDevelopment package audience "author", and the website's catalog/forge-release/forge-release.json carries the same field
ForgeDevelopment/Native/Plugin.cs:29-33 returns before binding settings or patching anything when HostPlugin.ConfiguredMode is not RuntimeMode.Authoring
ForgeDevelopment/Native/ForgeDevelopment.Native.csproj:18 includes Native/*.cs, so the new files need no csproj change
authorGate.consequence: a player machine that does not install ForgeDevelopment has no endpoint at all, and a request naming one is answered no-consumer by the network layer

unverified: nothing in this slice was run in the game: the rows are exercised by ForgeDevelopment/tests/DevelopmentModule over a fixture kernel, and whether the authoring session is actually reachable from an authored plan needs a game run

the catalog still spells the session handle kind as `subscription` and the assert policy as report/halt, so until the catalog batch lands the site's rows and the registered rows differ by those two members
the `fields` projection of inspect names the entity observation contract's own columns; a future snapshot field added by another provider would need the projection list extended here as well
